applied.problem: "Wait 5 minutes" is stated as a general rule, but 5 minutes is one maker's figure for one drive range; some drives need longer, so the wait must follow the drive's own marked time before measuring.
The safety row gives one maker's 5-minute wait as universal; the 5% THD cap is a NATO warship standard (8% under civil ship rules), not all warship rules; "any frequency" overstates a drive's range.
The keep card gives "wait 5 minutes" as a general rule; its cited quote is one ABB drive's figure and other drives can need longer.

"A transformer is never meant to run above its rated frequency" is too absolute: a 50 Hz transformer runs safely at 60 Hz (less flux) and many are rated 50/60 Hz; the real contrast is a fixed versus a varied supply frequency.
"Start from the last two lessons" is wrong: the field speed 120 × f ÷ p and slip come from the first lesson; the second (the DOL starter) does not teach them.
